raw_text: {"competitors":[],"summary":"This Dell Technologies filing describes competition only in generic terms — \"branded and generic competitors,\" \"companies that specialize in one or more of our product or service lines,\" and \"non-traditional IT companies, including large Infrastructure-as-a-Service providers\" — without naming any specific rival firm.
